title: PowerFly HZEB-LCT-16 16.07kWh Wall-Mounted Battery
summary: A 16.07kWh 51.2V LiFePO4 battery with 314Ah cells and a 150A rating, sized for larger homes and small commercial backup.
applications: Retrofit with an existing low-voltage inverter

faqs.question: What can a 150A battery actually run?
faqs.answer: 150A at 51.2V is 7.68kW at nominal voltage, so it carries a 6kW inverter with margin; at the 44.8V low end the same current gives 6.72kW.

faqs.question: How does it compare with the 10.54kWh model?
faqs.answer: Same platform and cabinet family, but 314Ah cells instead of 206Ah and a 150A rating instead of 100A, so it carries a larger inverter as well as more energy.

faqs.question: Can it be installed outdoors?
faqs.answer: It is IP54 and rated for wall or ground mounting, and the datasheet claims resistance to 200mm of continuous rain. Siting still matters: keep it off a flood path and within the 0-55 C charging window.
